text:
acme-eng: Hey, saw a customer report where their embedding indexer started failing after we pinned variants. intermittently they get 1536-length vectors (expected) and 1024-length vectors (unexpected) in the same stream. assertion in their pipeline: AssertionError: expected veclen 1536 got 1024

acme-eng: Quick snippet from their error log:
```
IndexingError: batch 42 failed
expected_dim=1536 actual_dim=1024
request_id=req_0a12b3c4
```

sarah: Sorry you're seeing that — can you confirm whether the customer pinned a variant or used a reserved model alias? also their request id above helps, thanks :eyes:

acme-eng: They said they pinned `redwood-emb-prod:locked-20260314` via our Console. header they send: `X-Redwood-Pinned-Variant: redwood-emb-prod:locked-20260314`. Repro is intermittent, ~1/20 calls return 1024 vectors. No schema conversion on their side.

kevin: Intermittent suggests routing fallback or variant-substitution. Do we have any fallback rules that can return a different embedding schema when the pinned pool is saturated?

alex: Looking at routing logs for req_0a12b3c4 — it shows elected variant `redwood-emb-lite-1024` for some shards while other shards used `redwood-emb-prod-1536`. This happened during a short burst when reserved capacity temporarily returned 502 from one replica, triggering our fallback policy.

alex: Root cause hypothesis: pinned alias resolves to multiple compatible model families in the catalog; our fallback policy allowed a smaller-dimension variant as a compatible substitute in order to keep latency, but we do not currently validate embedding schema compatibility at the router layer.

sarah: Ok, immediate mitigation for the customer: force strict variant pinning in request (works) or add a schema check that rejects responses with mismatched dims before ingest. Example cURL to force exact variant:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Pinned-Variant: redwood-emb-prod-1536-v2" \
  -d '{"input":"...","model":"embed-tiny"}'
```

kevin: Another mitigation: set `allow_fallback=false` on the customer's reserved config so router will queue or error instead of substituting.

acme-eng: Customer tried forcing `X-Redwood-Pinned-Variant` and saw no 1024s in 1k calls — seems to fix it. but they want a permanent fix so other customers don't hit this.

eng-runtime: We'll push a routing change to validate embedding schema at selection time and to avoid substituting across incompatible embedding widths. Patch ID: RT-2026-042. Impact: small routing latency increase when variant resolution happens, but prevents silent schema flips.

kevin: Filed internal follow-up: ticket INF-embed-schema-check. Assigning to eng-runtime and console to expose `allow_fallback` for pinned aliases.

support-bot: Logged support ticket REDW-17890 and linked to INF-embed-schema-check.

acme-eng: Customer is happy with the workaround for now, will wait for your fix. thanks :thumbsup:

sarah: Marking thread triaged — patch to validate schemas in router is scheduled for next deploy window. will post a follow-up when merged :white_check_mark:

eng-runtime: After deploy we'll run a canary against a synthetic workload that alternates the two variants to ensure router rejects incompatible substitutions.

acme-eng: great, will test once you let us know. thanks everyone.
